suggestion: Keep the title, gold counter, four exact menu destinations, and centered mystical hero, but strengthen the summoning event with a luminous ritual seal or altar beneath the spirit, a clearer spectral face/body edge, and particles visibly emerging through the veil. Increase the legibility of Roster, Battle, and Grind subtitles/icons without competing with the active Summon card, so every requested hub destination remains substantively actionable rather than receding into decoration.
